name: rescuebite-backend
description: RescueBite Cambodia - Standalone PostgreSQL Express Backend Service

scriptsComments.dev: Runs development server with hot reload via tsx on port 5000
scriptsComments.build: Compiles TypeScript files into dist/ folder
scriptsComments.start: Runs compiled production server from dist/server.js
scriptsComments.db:setup: Executes PostgreSQL DDL migrations and seeds initial demo data
scriptsComments.db:start: Starts the dedicated local PostgreSQL database server on port 5432
scriptsComments.db:stop: Stops the dedicated local PostgreSQL database server
